title: Alyvo — Multilingual showcase site
summary: Multilingual site with dynamic content management, continuous deployment and SEO performance optimised for three European markets.

details.tagline: A website that lives, scales and converts in three languages.

need.context: A young SaaS brand targeting France, the United Kingdom and Spain with a small technical team.
need.problem: No site able to handle content in three languages, poor mobile performance and almost no organic traffic.
need.objective: Build a fast, multilingual showcase, optimised for SEO and easy to maintain without going back to a developer for every change.

stakes: Reach three markets with one coherent website
Let the team publish content without depending on tech

solution.what: A server-rendered Nuxt site, with JSON-based content and automated deployments on Kubernetes.
solution.why: A modern, low-maintenance stack that pairs raw performance with native SEO for each language.
solution.how: Localised routes, per-page SEO markup, dynamic sitemap and automatic deployments on every commit.

features: Native dark mode with system preference
results: Lighthouse score above 95 across all three languages
Time to publish a new page reduced by 4x
First organic traffic in under two months

title: Sigma — Custom business software
summary: Web application with REST API, real-time dashboards and automation of critical workflows for 50 collaborators.

details.tagline: One tool that replaces ten Excel files and zero humans.

need.context: A 50-person SMB was running its entire operation on shared Excel files and email threads.
need.problem: Duplicated data, recurring mistakes, daily lost time and zero real-time visibility on production.
need.objective: Centralise the data, automate what could be automated and give managers a real-time view of operations.

stakes: Make the company's critical data reliable
Reduce the cognitive load on operational teams
Give managers the right indicators at the right time

solution.what: A web application with a secured REST API, real-time dashboards and automated business workflows.
solution.why: A custom tool that fits the actual processes, without unnecessary overhead or per-user licensing.
solution.how: Business modelling, typed API, integrations with existing tools and automations on repetitive tasks.

results: 8 hours per week saved per collaborator
Data entry errors reduced by more than 80%
Management decisions driven by reliable data

title: DocFlow — AI document automation
summary: Intelligent document processing with OCR, AI classification and orchestration through automated workflows.

details.tagline: When AI digests the paperwork so your team can focus on the thinking.

need.context: A back-office team was processing thousands of incoming documents every month, manually.
need.problem: Manual data entry, approximate classification, growing delays and team fatigue.
need.objective: Automate extraction and classification while keeping a human in the loop for sensitive cases.

stakes: Meet the processing SLAs promised to clients
Free the team from repetitive tasks
Keep control and traceability over decisions

solution.what: A pipeline that combines OCR, an AI model for classification and orchestration through automated workflows.
solution.why: AI only matters when wired into a real workflow: value comes from the full chain, not from the model alone.
solution.how: OCR extraction, automatic classification, human supervision on ambiguous cases and normalised exports to business tools.

features: Human supervision workflow for edge cases
Full pipeline logging and audit trail
results: Over 90% of documents processed without human input
